markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 第三条件句说**过去没发生的事**：「当时要是……就会……」，常用来后悔或庆幸。混合条件句把过去和现在连起来：「当时要是……**现在**就……」。

uses.en: If I [[had tested]] it, I [[would have found]] the bug.
uses.en_zh: 我当时要是测一下，就能发现这个 bug 了。

uses.en: If we [[hadn't left]] early, we [[would have missed]] the train.
uses.en_zh: 我们要是没早点出发，就赶不上火车了。

uses.zh: 混合：过去的事影响现在
uses.en: If I [[had taken]] that job, I [[would be]] in London now.
uses.en_zh: 我当时要是接了那份工作，现在就在伦敦了。

third.title: 第三条件句：当时要是……
third.rule: 两半说的都是**过去**，而且**都没真的发生**。if 那半用 had done，另一半用 would have done。

examples.en: If you [[had told]] me, I [[would have helped]].
examples.zh: 你当时要是告诉我，我就帮你了。

examples.en: If it [[hadn't rained]], we [[would have gone]] to the beach.
examples.zh: 要不是下雨，我们就去海边了。

examples.en: If I [[had known]] about the meeting, I [[would have come]].
examples.zh: 我要是知道有这个会，我就来了。

wrong.bad: If I ~~would have known~~, I'd have come.
wrong.good: If I [[had known]], I'd have come.

speak.title: 口语里怎么说
speak.rule: 说话时会缩得很短，两个 'd 意思不一样：**if 后面的 'd 是 had，另一半的 'd 是 would。**

examples.rule: 第一个 'd = had，第二个 'd = would
examples.en: If I[['d]] known, I[['d]] have come.

examples.rule: would have 读起来像 would've
examples.zh: 我本来会给你打电话的。

notes: would've 听起来像 would of，但**写的时候一定是 would have**。

items.en: If you'd asked, I [[could have]] helped.
items.zh: 你当时要是问一句，我本来能帮上忙的。

items.en: If we'd tested more, we [[might have]] caught it.
items.zh: 我们当时多测一些，说不定就发现了。

items.en: If she hadn't reminded me, I [[wouldn't have]] remembered.
items.zh: 要不是她提醒我，我就忘了。

mixed.title: 混合条件句：过去和现在连起来
mixed.rule: 过去的事影响**现在**：If + had done，另一半用 would + 动词原形。现在的情况影响**过去**：If + 过去时，另一半用 would have done。

items.en: If I [[had taken]] that job, I [[would be]] in London <<now>>.
items.zh: 我当时要是接了那份工作，现在就在伦敦了。

items.en: If I [[hadn't stayed]] up so late, I [[wouldn't be]] so tired <<today>>.
items.zh: 我昨晚要是没熬那么晚，今天就不会这么累。

items.rule: 现在 → 过去：我一直都害羞
items.en: If I [[weren't]] so shy, I [[would have spoken]] up in the meeting.
items.zh: 我要不是这么害羞，会上就发言了。

mixed.tip: 先问自己：「原因」是过去还是现在？「结果」是过去还是现在？各用各的。

this.en: If I [[had had]] time, I[['d have helped]] you.

that.en: If I [[had]] time, I[['d help]] you.

this.en: If I'd slept, I [[would have felt]] better yesterday.

that.en: If I'd slept, I [[would feel]] better <<now>>.

commonMistakes.bad: If I ~~would have known~~, I'd have come.
commonMistakes.good: If I [[had known]], I'd have come.
commonMistakes.why: if 那半句用 had done。

commonMistakes.bad: If you had ~~came~~ earlier, you'd have met her.
commonMistakes.good: If you had [[come]] earlier, you'd have met her.
commonMistakes.why: had 后面用过去分词 come。

commonMistakes.bad: If I ~~knew~~ yesterday, I'd have told you.
commonMistakes.good: If I [[had known]] yesterday, I'd have told you.
commonMistakes.why: 过去没发生的事，用 had known。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我当时要是测一下，就能发现这个 bug 了。
quiz.answer: If I had tested it, I would have found the bug.
accept: If I'd tested it, I'd have found the bug.
If I had tested it, I'd have found the bug.
If I'd tested it, I would have found the bug.
If I had tested it, I could have found the bug.
quiz.explain: 过去没发生：If + [[had tested]]，另一半 [[would have found]]。

quiz.prompt: If you ___ (tell) me, I would have helped.
accept: 'd told

traps.note: if 那半句不用 would，用 had told。

quiz.prompt: If it hadn't rained, we ___ (go) to the beach.
accept: 'd have gone
would've gone

traps.note: have 后面用过去分词 gone。

quiz.prompt: 改成第三条件句：I didn't know about the meeting, so I didn't come.
quiz.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have come.
accept: If I'd known about the meeting, I'd have come.
If I had known about the meeting, I'd have come.
If I'd known about the meeting, I would have come.
quiz.explain: 事实反过来说：If I [[had known]] …, I [[would have come]]。

quiz.prompt: If I'd known, I'd have come. 第一个 'd 是：
改错：I would of helped you.
accept: I'd have helped you.
I would've helped you.

quiz.prompt: If you'd asked, I ___ helped.（本来能够）
If we'd tested more, we ___ ___ caught it.（说不定会）
If I had taken that job, I ___ in London now.
quiz.explain: 原因在过去，结果在现在（<<now>>）→ [[would be]]。

quiz.prompt: If I hadn't stayed up so late, I ___ (not be) so tired today.
accept: would not be

quiz.prompt: 用混合条件句改写：I didn't learn French at school, so I can't speak it now.
quiz.answer: If I had learnt French at school, I could speak it now.
accept: If I had learned French at school, I could speak it now.
If I'd learnt French at school, I could speak it now.
If I'd learned French at school, I could speak it now.
If I had learnt French at school, I would be able to speak it now.
If I had learned French at school, I would be able to speak it now.
quiz.explain: 过去 → 现在：If + [[had learnt]]，另一半 [[could]] + 原形。

quiz.prompt: 当时没时间：If I ___ time, I'd have helped you.
quiz.explain: 过去的事 → had + 过去分词：[[had had]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：If you had came earlier, you'd have met her.
quiz.answer: If you had come earlier, you'd have met her.
accept: If you had come earlier, you would have met her.
If you'd come earlier, you'd have met her.
If you'd come earlier, you would have met her.

quiz.prompt: 改错：If I knew yesterday, I'd have told you.
quiz.answer: If I had known yesterday, I'd have told you.
accept: If I had known yesterday, I would have told you.
If I'd known yesterday, I'd have told you.
quiz.explain: 过去没发生的事：If I [[had known]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：If I would have known, I'd have come.
quiz.answer: If I had known, I'd have come.
accept: If I had known, I would have come.
If I'd known, I'd have come.

openTask.prompt: 回想一次工作或生活里的小失误，用 3 句话说：当时要是……就会……；再用一句混合条件句说它对现在的影响。
rules: 第三条件句：If + had done，另一半 would have done
if 那半句不用 would；写 would have，不写 would of
openTask.note: 规则判 had done / would have done 搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
